list.desc: Suwon spots from LalaHappy's "9 K-Drama Filming Locations in Suwon You Can Actually Visit (2026 Guide)" (https://lalahappyblog.com/2026/04/28/9-k-drama-filming-locations-in-suwon/). Collected by PinWith, not made by LalaHappy.

items.title: Hwahongmun Gate (Buksumun)
items.memo: Lovely Runner romantic scene; best around sunset

items.title: Banghwasuryujeong Pavilion
items.memo: Tied to Twenty-Five Twenty-One; great city views from the walls

items.title: Mong Ted Cafe (Im Sol's House)
items.memo: Lovely Runner's Im Sol home; try coffee and salt bread

items.title: Kazaguruma (카자구루마)
items.memo: Extraordinary Attorney Woo's gimbap shop exterior; serves katsu

items.title: Haenggung-dong
items.memo: Neighborhood used in several dramas; murals and indie cafes
items.check: Article names the area, not one spot; pinned at the mural village

items.title: Suwon Hwaseong Fortress
items.memo: UNESCO fortress linked to Twenty-Five Twenty-One; walk the wall
items.check: Article names the whole fortress; pinned at Paldalmun Gate

items.title: Wolhwawon Garden (월화원)
items.memo: Chinese-style garden from Moon Lovers: Scarlet Heart Ryeo

items.title: Suwon Irwol Arboretum
items.memo: Fan-cited Queen of Tears spot (unconfirmed); greenhouse walks
